lesson.introText: Today, we’ll talk about Spain. We’ll see youtuber Tina explore the city of Valencia.

warmup.question: How well do you know Spanish culture?
modelAnswers: I actually don’t know a lot about it.

warmup.question: Did you know that more than 40% of Spanish people speak English?

video.instrucao: Teacher: pause the video from time to time to check comprehension.

conversation.question: Which words did you understand from the video?
What’s your opinion about the video?
modelAnswers: In my opinion, it is... funny / interesting / nice / cool.

conversation.question: Can you speak Spanish?
modelAnswers: Yes, I can. / No, I can’t.

conversation.question: Would you like to visit Valencia?
Would you like to visit other Spanish speaking countries?
modelAnswers: Yes, (Chile) for example. / No, I wouldn’t.

conversation.question: Do you like to see the sunset?
Have you ever rented a bike?
modelAnswers: No, I have never rented a bike.
Yes, I have already rented a bike.

evaluation.question: Did you enjoy talking about Spain?
Which other countries would you like to learn more about?
